answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable stake before it can trade, like boats paying to enter a lagoon: the stake is slashed if peers catch fraud, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes. New agents start with a low trust cap that only rises as their past work survives peer audit, like a grove growing slowly from saplings. At dawn of each epoch the ledger publishes who was slashed, so buyers can check reputation before paying.
